items: 【High Performance tablet】 Featuring 20GB RAM(Including 16GB of extended memory) and a powerful octa-core, this tablet is powered by the latest Android 16 operating system, which ensures fast app launches, smooth running of games and videos, and a faster, more responsive experience.

【2 in 1 Tablet】 tablet with Foldable upright Case Bluetooth Wireless Mouse Stylus pen keyboard and more, In order to provide convenience for your work, life and entertainment, you can switch three modes of use at any time, 128GB ROM With Google Play pre-installed, you can download apps like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and more. This is for Family, Students, Business people, Writers with the best gift.

【Android 16 High Performance Tablet】 The tablet is powered by the latest Android 16. Faster than Android 15. Compatible with more apps. Powerful octa-core CPU with up to 2.0Ghz makes you play games, watch movies, surf the internet and work online more smoothly. More stable and faster when running a tablet. Supports multitasking without lagging

【GMS Google Certified】 Android 16 tablet 11 inch is certified by Google, ensuring that you can access all of your favorite Google apps and services, including Google Play Store, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Tiktok, WhatsApp, G-mail, Skype, Disney+, Netflix, Line, Instagram, ZOOM and more brilliant apps.

【The Perfect Gift】 With excellent performance, stylish appearance and elegant packaging, this tablet can be used for watching videos, online learning, surfing the Internet, video conferencing, gaming and entertainment. It's perfect for Christmas, Valentine's Day, birthdays and bar mitzvahs.
